text:
raj_platform: Quick flag — noticed a mismatch between invoice preview and ledger for tenants using per-route quota overrides + model-variant routing. Preview shows quota-applied tokens still included, ledger excludes them.
maya_ops: can you paste an example tenant and the preview vs ledger numbers?
raj_platform: tenant=t-204, route=embedding-heavy, preview_tokens=1,200,000, ledger_tokens=800,000. The missing 400k are tokens that should have been throttled by quota enforcement. Preview index receives pre-throttle events; ledger gets post-throttle events after quota gateway.
sara_billing: that explains customer confusion. They see higher preview and expect invoice to match. Do we want preview to show pre-throttle (what would have happened) or post-throttle (what will be invoiced)?
katie_sre: from SRE perspective, both are valuable. But default UI should reflect billable tokens (post-throttle). Maybe provide an optional "potential" view that includes pre-throttle counts for debugging.
oliver_api: runtime currently emits both: an incoming request event (requested_tokens) and a final served event (served_tokens) if accepted. Quota gateway short-circuits and emits a quota_reject event when rejected. Nearline preview currently aggregates any event with tokens set, so it counts requested_tokens and served_tokens.
raj_platform: proposal: update preview ingestion to classify rows by `billing_phase`: requested|served|throttled. Default preview aggregation should sum served only. Add API param `include_requested_for_debug=true` to opt-in.
sara_billing: agree. Also need preview_meta that exposes counts per phase: {served_tokens, requested_tokens, throttled_tokens}. That way support can explain differences at a glance.
maya_ops: implementation concerns: we tag events with billing_phase in runtime, but older events don't have it. We'll need a normalization step that infers phase: if event has `quota_status=REJECTED` -> throttled, if has `served_tokens` field -> served, else requested. Add a migration to backfill last 7 days?
katie_sre: backfill could be heavy. Instead mark historical previews with preview_meta.inferred_billing_phase=true and show a small warning. Backfill only for top 50 tenants if needed.
oliver_api: telemetry needs: preview_phase_ratio per tenant, preview_requested_vs_served_delta, and an alert if served_tokens < 75% of requested_tokens for top tenants (indicates aggressive throttling).
raj_platform: UI changes: 1) default preview card labeled "Estimated invoiced tokens (post-quota)" 2) expandable breakdown by phase with numbers 3) optional toggle "Show requested tokens". Also show an icon if preview is using inferred phases.
sara_billing: support copy: explain "Requested tokens = what apps attempted; Served tokens = what we billed; Throttled tokens = attempts blocked by quota. Preview defaults to Served." Will add to KB.
maya_ops: rollout plan: - Phase A (canary): change preview aggregation to prefer served tokens where billing_phase present and expose preview_meta. Enable for 10% tenants tomorrow 02:00 UTC. - Phase B: if stable, infer phases for recent 7d for those tenants and show inferred flag. - Phase C: full rollout and optional backfill for top customers who request it.
katie_sre: performance note: classifying rows will add a small CPU step in nearline ingestion (~30ms). Can we gate it behind a flag `preview_classify_phase=true`?
raj_platform: yes gate + sampling. We'll also add headroom alerts if nearline_ingest_latency_p50 > 200ms.
oliver_api: update runtime to tag billing_phase on emits. Also include optional `request_id` so preview dedupe can use it when present.
billing-bot: [automated] Created ticket BP-5091: "preview billing_phase classification + UI meta" assigned to raj_platform, maya_ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/BP-5091
raj_platform: owners: oliver_api -> emit billing_phase + request_id, maya_ops -> preview ingestion flag + sampling + rollout, sara_billing -> preview_meta spec + KB, katie_sre -> monitor SLOs and canary alerts.
maya_ops: i'll post the canary schedule in #eng-platform-ops and add a checklist for rollback.
raj_platform: small follow-up: add an API param `window_mode=served|requested|both` so advanced users can query whichever they want. Default `served`.
sara_billing: agree, and include a `preview_delta_reason` string in preview_meta when delta > 10% (e.g., "quota_throttling" or "routing_attempts_included"). That will help triage.
katie_sre: sounds good. Let's sync after canary metrics are in. :thumbsup:
